question: Tell me about a time you used analysis to make a recommendation.
source: Production /api/free-tasters: weak submission and its returned rewrite, both scored by quickInterviewScore / applyScorePolicy; typed answers

rewrite.title: Your answer, fixed
rewrite.before: At Redcliffe Partners I supported the team with research on software companies. I looked at the information and helped put it in a spreadsheet. We discussed which companies looked good. I just tried to help the team make a recommendation and got through it.

parts.text: My example is from my corporate finance intern role at Redcliffe Partners.

I researched 12 UK software companies for a prospective acquisition screen. I recorded business descriptions, revenue and EBITDA where publicly available in an Excel comparison table. I flagged 4 companies for further review because their recurring revenue models matched the screen brief.
I presented the comparison table and selection reasons to an associate.
